name: dev-layout
description: Opens the terminal split into a shell and an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex or your own command) when a project window opens.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted folders nothing runs automatically: the layout waits until the folder is trusted, and whether it opens and what it runs come only from user/profile settings, never from the folder's .vscode/settings.json.

devLayout.autoOpen.description: Build the terminal layout automatically when a project window opens (only if the window has no terminals yet).

devLayout.agent.markdownDescription: The AI agent to start in the agent terminal.

devLayout.agentCommand.markdownDescription: Command for the agent terminal. Empty: `claude` or `codex`. Add flags here, e.g. `claude --model opus` or `codex --full-auto`; with agent **Custom**, any command.

devLayout.continueSession.markdownDescription: Resume the project's last conversation: Claude Code gets `--continue` when the project has one, Codex runs `codex resume --last` (which starts a new session when there's none). Not used for a Custom agent.

devLayout.shellPane.description: Open a shell terminal next to the agent. Off: only the agent terminal.

devLayout.shellCommand.markdownDescription: Optional command to run in the shell terminal, e.g. `git status`.

devLayout.focus.description: Which terminal has the focus once the layout is ready.

devLayout.agentSize.description: Share of the split for the agent terminal: width when side by side (bottom panel), height when stacked (sidebar).

enumDescriptions: Right of the shell, or below it when stacked.
Left of the shell, or above it when stacked.

devLayout.sidebarWidth.description: When the terminal lives in the secondary sidebar: its width as a share of the window (e.g. 0.35). 0 leaves the width alone.

devLayout.restoreDelayMs.description: How long to wait after the window opens for VS Code to restore terminals before deciding whether to build the layout.

devLayout.fallbackResizeSteps.description: Resize steps (4 columns each) toward the agent terminal if the terminal width can't be measured.
